title: AI Solution Architect
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY:** We are looking for an AI Solution Architect who can take an enterprise AI initiative from vision to execution. You will shape AI strategy with C-level stakeholders, architect cloud-native GenAI and ML platforms on Azure and Databricks, and lead cross-functional teams across data science, MLOps and product engineering to deliver them. You are equally comfortable presenting a roadmap to a board, reviewing a RAG pipeline design and coaching an engineer through a production incident.

**Experience**

* 12+ years in data, analytics or software engineering, including 5+ years leading AI/ML platforms or products in an enterprise setting.
* Proven record of taking ML and GenAI solutions into production at scale, with measurable business impact.
* Hands-on delivery of at least one production LLM/RAG solution, plus hands-on experience with agentic AI patterns.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and presenting to C-level executives.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field.

**Cloud & MLOps:** Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault), Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD

**Data & ML:** Python, SQL, PySpark, MLflow, TensorFlow, Gurobi, Dataiku, SAS, Alteryx

**GenAI & Agentic AI:** OpenAI and other LLMs, LangChain, Milvus / vector databases, RAG, prompt engineering, memory agents, NLP, LLM evaluation

**BI & Visualisation:** Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik

**Leadership Competencies:**

* AI strategy and roadmap execution
* AI/ML product lifecycle management
* Responsible AI and governance
* Stakeholder engagement and executive communication
* Training, change management and AI adoption
* Cross-functional team leadership
* Vendor and partner collaboration

**Nice to Have**

* Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer, Databricks ML Professional or TOGAF.
* Experience with AWS or GCP AI services, or multi-cloud architectures.
* Industry exposure in financial services, energy, healthcare, manufacturing or the public sector.
* Experience designing or delivering AI training and enablement content.

**SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS**

* An agreed AI roadmap and reference architecture adopted across key client engagements.
* At least two GenAI or ML solutions in production with tracked business value.
* A working Responsible AI and MLOps framework reused by delivery teams.
* A high-performing, cross-functional team and a strong bench of client executive relationships.

**Reports to: Chief Executive Officer / Head of AI**

 **Requirements**

**AI Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and own AI strategy and multi-year roadmaps aligned to client and C-level business priorities, with clear value metrics (revenue, cost, risk, productivity).
* Lead the full AI/ML product lifecycle: opportunity discovery, business case, architecture, build, deployment, adoption and value tracking.
* Build, mentor and lead agile delivery teams spanning data scientists, ML/MLOps engineers, data engineers and product managers.
* Act as a trusted advisor to executives, translating complex technical options into clear decisions on investment, risk and trade-offs.

**Solution Architecture & Delivery**

* Architect enterprise-grade, cloud-native AI/ML and analytics platforms on Azure (ADF, Azure ML, Synapse, Event Hubs, Key Vault) and Databricks.
* Design and deliver GenAI and agentic AI solutions: LLM integrations (OpenAI and others), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g. Milvus), prompt engineering, memory-enabled agents and NLP pipelines.
* Establish MLOps foundations using MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform for reproducible training, CI/CD, monitoring and scalable model serving.
* Set architecture standards, reference designs and reusable components that reduce time-to-production across engagements.
* Guide data and analytics solutions end to end, from pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark) to optimisation (Gurobi) and BI dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, Qlik).

**Responsible AI & Governance**

* Define and embed Responsible AI practices: fairness, explainability, privacy, security, model risk management and human oversight.
* Design governance for GenAI, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, hallucination and prompt-injection controls, cost monitoring and audit trails.
* Ensure solutions comply with relevant regulations and client policies (e.g. PDPA, GDPR, MAS FEAT principles where applicable).

**Stakeholder, Change & Adoption**

* Engage business, IT, security and risk stakeholders to align scope, secure buy-in and manage expectations.
* Lead training, change management and AI adoption programmes so solutions are used, trusted and sustained.
* Manage vendor and partner relationships (cloud providers, LLM providers, platform and SI partners), including evaluation, selection and commercial input.
* Produce clear executive communication: roadmaps, status reports, value realisation reviews and steering committee materials.

description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data\-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital\-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.


Role Overview
  
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands\-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data\-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current\-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build\-versus\-buy options, guide proof\-of\-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
* Define the MEEHS target architecture: Develop current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability: Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data\-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs: Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.
* Establish trusted information models: Define canonical data models, business vocabularies, identifiers, metadata standards, master and reference data alignment, and contextual relationships across projects, facilities, systems, equipment, documents, work processes, risks, and controls.
* Advance digital\-thread capabilities: Conceptualize and assess digital\-thread use cases connecting engineering design, project controls, construction, commissioning and qualification, asset handover, site operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS information.
* Assess feasibility and shape investments: Evaluate business value, technical feasibility, architecture fit, data readiness, integration complexity, cybersecurity, compliance, operating impact, cost, vendor capability, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Enable insights and AI readiness: Create governed data foundations that support operational dashboards, KPI reporting, predictive insights, AI\-assisted search, knowledge retrieval, machine\-learning use cases, and future agent\-enabled workflows. Design and build visualization layer using Power BI.
* Provide delivery leadership: Convert approved concepts into solution designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, data contracts, implementation roadmaps, technical work packages, non\-functional requirements, test strategies, deployment plans, and support models.
* Guide platform and vendor decisions: Lead technical evaluations of COTS, SaaS, cloud, data, integration, analytics, and AI technologies; assess vendor roadmaps and architecture claims; and recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Embed security, privacy, and compliance: Incorporate secure\-by\-design, least\-privilege access, identity federation, encryption, logging, monitoring, data classification, privacy, records management, GMP/GxP, validation, and audit\-readiness requirements.
* Partner through a product mindset: Work with Product Managers to connect user needs and business outcomes to capabilities, roadmaps, backlogs, release increments, adoption measures, product health, value realization, and total cost of ownership.

**Primary Skills:** TOGAF
  
  

* API Architecture (REST, OData, Web Services)
* Data Architecture (Lakes, Lakehouse, Warehouse)

AI/Machine Learning Architecture

* Pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing experience is preferred. Experience in other industrial manufacturing sectors supporting engineering, maintenance, asset reliability, construction, manufacturing operations, or EHS will also be considered.


Technical Knowledge
  
* Architecture methods and modeling: Capability mapping, domain architecture, reference architectures, architecture principles, transition roadmaps, architecture decision records, non\-functional requirements, design reviews, and modeling approaches such as ArchiMate or UML.
* Integration and interoperability: API\-first and event\-driven architecture; REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, OData, webhooks, message queues, event streaming, API gateways, iPaaS, middleware, ETL/ELT, managed file transfer, and data contracts.
* Data architecture and governance: Relational and NoSQL models, warehouses, lakes and lakehouses, data products, semantic layers, master and reference data, metadata catalogs, lineage, quality, stewardship, retention, archival, and role\-based access.
* Cloud and platform architecture: Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud services; SaaS, PaaS, containers, serverless services, hybrid integration, network patterns, availability, resilience, backup, disaster recovery, observability, and environment strategy.
* Digital engineering and MEEHS domains: Engineering information management, CAD/BIM, project controls, common data environments, asset information, CMMS, condition monitoring, predictive reliability, EHS systems, electronic work permits, risk assessments, project\-to\-operations handover, digital threads, and digital twins.

* Cybersecurity and identity: Zero Trust, secure\-by\-design, IAM, SSO, MFA, RBAC, PAM, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, certificates, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, threat modeling, audit logging, and secure vendor connectivity.
* Regulated delivery and operations: SDLC, Computer System Assurance, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 principles, GMP/GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 concepts, ALCOA data integrity, change and release control, traceability, periodic review, incident and problem management, and audit readiness.


Non\-Technical Skills and Competencies
  
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to connect business capabilities, processes, applications, integrations, information, technology, controls, operating models, and measurable outcomes.
* Product\-centered mindset with a focus on user needs, business value, reusable capabilities, roadmap sequencing, adoption, product health, lifecycle sustainability, technical debt, and total cost of ownership.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts clearly to business stakeholders, product teams, engineers, quality and security partners, vendors, and senior leadership.

* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead through ambiguity without losing delivery discipline.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, manage conflicting priorities, constructively challenge assumptions, and build alignment within a global matrix organization.
* Inclusive and collaborative leadership style that invites diverse perspectives, shares knowledge, develops others, and establishes trust across technical and non\-technical teams.


Preferred Certifications
  
  

* TOGAF, ArchiMate, or a comparable enterprise and solution architecture certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
* DAMA Certified Data Management Professional, Databricks Data Engineer, or comparable data architecture and governance certification.


Working Hours and Expectations
  
  

* This is primarily an office\-based position. The successful candidate is expected to work on\-site a minimum of three days per week to support effective architecture collaboration, stakeholder engagement, design workshops, knowledge sharing, and team development.
* Collaborate across global time zones and provide reasonable overlap for scheduled meetings with manufacturing sites, enterprise teams, vendors, and product stakeholders.
* Participate in planned architecture workshops, proof\-of\-concept activities, releases, cutovers, disaster\-recovery exercises, and occasional off\-hours support for critical implementation or production events in accordance with established procedures.
* Occasional travel may be required to support manufacturing sites, project teams, vendor engagements, architecture workshops, or implementation activities.


Performance Measures
  
* Delivery of approved current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures, reference patterns, architecture decisions, implementation roadmaps, and technical work packages aligned with agreed scope and outcomes.
* Successful interoperability outcomes demonstrated through secure, reliable, supportable, and reusable integrations between platforms and critical enterprise systems.
* Progress in establishing central data hubs with trusted ingestion, transformation, metadata, lineage, quality, semantic modeling, access, and consumption capabilities.
* Business acceptance and measurable use of governed data for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and prioritized AI use cases.

* Compliance with architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, GMP/GxP, validation, data integrity, records, operational resilience, and audit\-readiness requirements.
* Reduction of duplicate integrations, fragmented data flows, unsupported technologies, manual reconciliation, technical debt, vendor dependency, and lifecycle risk through documented architecture actions.
* Consistently demonstrates strong work ethic, ownership, accountability, integrity, and sound judgment while fostering inclusive, respectful, and collaborative behavior, sharing knowledge, seeking diverse perspectives, and contributing positively to cross\-functional team outcomes.

title: Senior Lead, Infrastructure/Cloud Architecture
description:

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. Infrastructure Architects are the key link between Kyndryl and our clients. You’re in a technical leadership role, uniting and guiding stakeholders from clients, governance, and project executives to delivery and sometimes even the vendors who work with the client. You’ll be there from the start of a project — understanding what’s needed and figuring out the best technical solution. And you’ll be there at the finish, delivering the right product on time and within budget. As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation. At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre\-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities.The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients. Your future at Kyndryl This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.  

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience • Solid understanding of Data Center mainly Systems, Storage, Networking \& Security, Application \& Databases • Understanding of Systems and Solutions Architecture • Hands\-on experience \& learning with Data Center technologies, Cloud Software, and interoperability Preferred Technical and Professional Experience • MS Project or other Project Management software • Excellent written and verbal communication skills • Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
